## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). The footer is the record page's, drawn once. ⛔ No spec key

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T06:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** repeated provenance lines and a footer-only block. It is visual noise on a named producer (objectstack-ai/cloud's environment page). Nothing is wrong in the data.
- **The choice, made here: the host owns it.**
  - The record page draws one `RecordMetaFooter` for the record, whatever the number of `record:details` nodes.
  - A `DetailView` hosted on a record page no longer mounts its own. A standalone `DetailView` (no record-page host) keeps it.
  - ⛔ No `record:details` prop or spec key to switch it off. That would widen a published shape to work around a renderer's placement, and both measured faults are placement.
  - A node whose sections are all hidden then draws nothing.
  - **Pins:**
    - a page with two `record:details` nodes shows one footer;
    - an all-hidden node draws no block;
    - a standalone `DetailView` keeps its footer.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` and the record-page host (`domain:ui`); rationale: one record, one footer.

Claim: PM loop round 1, next slot (as triage `6140111288` directs: the record page draws one `RecordMetaFooter` for the record, whatever the number of `record:details` nodes; a `DetailView` hosted on a record page no longer mounts its own, a standalone `DetailView` keeps it, and a node whose sections are all hidden draws nothing; ⛔ no `record:details` prop or spec key)
Session: `session_01RZYixBnXPWvcm2YenWo6eJ`
Account: `os-support-ai` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12307-one-provenance-footer`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12307`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface, on objectui `main` `068a540`:
- **The footer's mount:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, where it mounts `<RecordMetaFooter` unconditionally.
- **The record-page host:** whichever renders the record page's `record:details` nodes and can own one footer per record. The dev measures it: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (which already says provenance is surfaced by `<RecordMetaFooter>`), or the `record:details` renderer in `packages/plugin-detail/src/`. How a hosted `DetailView` learns it is hosted (an existing context, or one the host provides) is also the dev's to measure.
- **Read and reused, ⛔ not changed:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordMetaFooter.tsx`.
- Co-located tests (the three pins), and `.changeset/12307-one-provenance-footer.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, plus `@object-ui/app-shell` if touched; ⛔ never `major`).
- ⛔ No `record:details` prop, no spec key, and no new published prop on `DetailView` unless no other mechanism exists. If one must be added, stop and report it rather than ship it.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the published `DetailView` stops drawing its own footer when a record page hosts it, which narrows what it renders and widens no accept set. As a narrowing, it owes one contract-tier review before the queue. If the dev must add a published prop or export, the report says so and the line is re-judged.
Responsibility: `objectui's detail renderer (@object-ui/plugin-detail DetailView), which mounts RecordMetaFooter in every DetailView, so a record page with N record:details nodes draws N identical provenance footers and an all-hidden node draws a footer-only block | the record page itself is the one place that knows the page's record once (triage 6140111288) | every user of a record page that authors more than one record:details node, measured on objectstack-ai/cloud's sys_environment_detail page (2 footers, and 3 plus a footer-only block in a one-node-per-section variant)`

The last change to `DetailView.tsx` on `main` is `5c2982adf` (2026-10-12, the record approval lock), which has landed.
- **Neighbours:** seat 1's in-flight objectui#12305 (`HomeAppsStrip`), #12306 (the metadata-admin header), #12310 (`data-table`'s pending edits), #12295 (`data-objectstack`, `AppHeader`) and #12300 (`AppManagementPage`) share no file. ## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12323 (head `0b74a1a`) · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01RZYixBnXPWvcm2YenWo6eJ` · 2026-10-13T09:25Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report. Inputs: claim `6140857825` and report `6142229511`.

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #12307`, and no other card number sits beside a closing keyword.
  - The PR body's `Clause-②:` line now reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. The seat added the arm, matching the claim's reason and the contract record. The body edit moved no head.
  - 9 files.
  - Two files go beyond the claim's list, both justified in the PR's Acceptance notes and both on the claim's own "record-page host" route: `PagePreview.tsx`, the Studio's second record-page host, and `recordPageProvenance.ts`, the internal context kept in its own module. The README is the docs-with-code rule.
- **The fix, read against the diff:**
  - `record:details` wraps its one `DetailView` in a `RecordPageProvenanceContext` whose value is "this node reads the page's record". That is `!isElementDataSourceConfig(schema.dataSource)`, the binding gate's own predicate.
  - `DetailView` skips its `RecordMetaFooter` when the context is true.
  - `RecordDetailView` draws one `RecordMetaFooter` for the page record at the page foot, after the page tree and its existing page-level appends.
  - The Studio preview mirrors that under its sample record.
  - A standalone `DetailView` and a bound `record:details` keep their own footers.
  - ⛔ No prop, export, type member or spec key. The context is not in the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` barrel.
- **Triage's pins (`6140111288`):** two nodes give one footer; an all-hidden node draws no block; a standalone `DetailView` keeps its footer. Also pinned: a bound node keeps its own. The dev's 2 ablation legs went red as pre-registered, with restore proven.
- **Contract review:** PASS `6142460015` on head `0b74a1a`. It enumerated every in-repo host: the runtime record page draws exactly one footer (and its three console mounts inherit it), the Studio preview mode one, and the Studio design canvas none. The canvas is the next note.
- **CI on `0b74a1a`:** 33 checks: 30 success, 3 skipped, none red.
- **Acceptance notes:**
  - **The Studio design canvas** (`PagePreview` design mode, `PageBlockCanvas` under `withRecordBinding`) now draws no provenance footer; before, it drew one per block. The canvas draws none of the page's other chrome either (header actions, save bar, the approvals and attachments appends), and preview mode shows the one footer. So this is accepted as within the card. If parity is wanted, it is one line: draw `RecordMetaFooter` under the canvas's last region. `carrier:` none.
  - **Placement:** on every default record page, the footer moves from inside the Details tab to the page foot, below the discussion feed, and is visible on every tab. That is within triage's direction ("the record page draws one", with no placement set). A different placement is a new card if the maintainer asks for one.
  - **The changeset body** states the behaviour change for an external host that mounts `RecordContextProvider` and renders `record:details`, with the remedy. It does not spell "BREAKING" as some earlier narrowings did. The `minor` level is right, and the gates are green. Left as is.
  - An all-hidden node still mounts empty wrapper divs that take one `space-y-4` slot. Polish. `carrier:` none.
- **Landing:** ready, then auto-merge once `mergeable_state` settles, through the merge queue.

## Landed: PR objectui#12323 → `main` `28ebfb5` · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01RZYixBnXPWvcm2YenWo6eJ` · 2026-10-13T09:40Z

- **The merge:** through the merge queue (`added_to_merge_queue` 2026-10-13T09:26Z, merged 2026-10-13T09:40Z). `Fixes #12307` closed this card `completed`.
- **Landed by content, not by sha:**
  - All 9 files of the PR on `main` `28ebfb5` are blob-identical to the accepted head `0b74a1a`. That head is covered by ACCEPT `6142485989` and contract review PASS `6142460015`.
  - `DetailView.tsx` on `main` reads `RecordPageProvenanceContext`, and `RecordDetailView.tsx` draws `<RecordMetaFooter` for the page.
- **Publishing:** nothing deploys on merge. The change ships with the maintainer's next `chore: release packages`, as `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `minor`. objectstack-ai/cloud's environment page (the card's measured producer) sees it at cloud's next `.objectui-sha` move.
- **This card:** `pm:dispatched` comes off with this note. The Acceptance notes in `6142485989` stand: the Studio design canvas has no footer, the footer sits at the page foot, and the changeset wording is as is.
